title: Phase 3: fixed additional scientific applications after mixed original results
group_split_rule: Seeded random order of unique groups; assign each whole group to the currently smallest row-count fold, with seeded random tie breaking
group_bootstrap_rule: Draw G observed groups with replacement, retain every row of each selected group with multiplicity; G is the original number of groups

conditional_baseline.fitting: SVD least squares with intercept and all non-target standardized coordinates; residual SD is sqrt(RSS/n)

stability.grid: All original observed covariate rows; prediction ignores the target column
stability.group_weight_sensitivity: Equal original group weight 1/(G*n_g); aggregation only, no likelihood reweighting
stability.comparisons: Paired same bootstrap indices; all finite and common score-eligible subsets; retain active bounds
stability.monte_carlo_uncertainty: Paired delete-one-bootstrap jackknife; no independent-row or population-efficiency confidence claim

datasets.label_role: Recorded river; descriptive external metadata only
datasets.scientific_target: Relative sodium enrichment in river-water cation mass composition
datasets.units: As-recorded cation mass ratios; no assertion of per-column molar concentration units

datasets.group_role: Country code used as geographic block
datasets.label_role: Recorded soilclass, with blanks retained; not assumed three true classes
datasets.scientific_target: Relative calcium enrichment conditional on other major-element ratios in soil
datasets.units: Ratios of selected elemental XRF concentrations in mg/kg

datasets.group_role: Unique original specimen row; no site/batch identifier is available
datasets.label_role: Recorded M/F/I sex/maturity category; not used in likelihood fitting or initialization
datasets.scientific_target: Shucked meat mass conditional on three shell dimensions
datasets.score_measure: Original published scaled measurement coordinates, with exact log-transform Jacobians
datasets.units: Published continuous values divided by 200; retain these stored units consistently
